lore:
Beneath the Church lies a concealed space.

The bishop kneels before the Tablet, chanting the secret words passed down from the dawn of creation.

Runes forgotten by time emit a responsive glow, manifesting a massive phantom at the bishop's will, bestowing "Bless" upon those bathed in its light.
